verdict.rationale: Cognee's documented MCP role is exclusively as an MCP *server* — external AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, Cline, Codex) connect to Cognee to use its memory tools, and the probe confirms cognee-mcp runs as a server answering JSON-RPC handshakes. There is no evidence Cognee itself acts as an MCP client that plugs in and consumes other MCP servers' tools; its product role is the tool-provider side, not the agent/client side, so this axis is a category mismatch for Cognee.
